QuestInfo.name: The Truth
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2152002##k says he has something to tell you about #m310000000#'s watchman, #p2152018#. Go see #b#p2152002##k and find out what it is.
QuestInfo.1:
According to #p2152002#, #p2152018# is originally from 
#m310000000#. He forced himself to become a part of the Black Wings, because he wanted to keep an eye on #p2154004#, his former lover currently being held hostage.

He says you should go to the walls of the mansion at 10 o'clock at night (UTC) if you want to confirm his story about #p2152018#. According to him, you will find #p2152018#, waiting patiently for his love #p2154004# to return.
QuestInfo.2: You returned after seeing #p2152018#. #p2152002# said that #p2152018# really wants to protect the town from the Black Wings, but can't, because #p2154004# is being held hostage. #p2152002# added that many people think #p2152018# betrayed his own town... #p2152002# said he hopes you don't think that, too.

0.0: Did #p2152018#'s bluntness offend you? He's never been a good conversationalist. He's been misunderstood since he was a kid. But he's not a bad guy. You probably don't know but #p2152018# is originally from #m310000000#. So why did he join the Black Wings?
0.1: Well, it wasn't so much that he wanted to join the Black Wings, but when his girlfriend, #p2154004#, was taken hostage, he joined so he could keep tabs on how she was doing.
0.2: You may not believe me, but it's true. I have an idea. #bGo near the wall of that house at 10pm#k. You'll be able to see #p2152018# pining for #p2154004#. You should try talking to him, too.

yes.0: #p2152018# probably doesn't want others to see that side of him but I really hate that he's so misunderstood. He's really not a bad guy.

no.0: Huh? You don't want to? Well, I guess you're right... You'd probably seem like a stalker.

1.0: #p2152018# really does care for this town, and he hates the Black Wings. He just can't let others know that. There are some people in town who consider #p2152018# a traitor. I hope that you won't think the same way.

yes.0: How long must I watch this tragedy... If only it could be wiped clean, like the street!

default.0: Have you not gone to see #p2152018# yet? #bGo near the wall of that house at 10pm.#k You should be able to see him. Just make sure you're there on time so you don't miss him. (Hint: head into the mansian at 10pm Pacific Time.)
